requiredBehaviors.behavior: distinguish controlled documents or blank forms from completed quality records that provide evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Document ≠ record explicitly states that controlled blank forms and procedures are not completed evidence records.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify attribution time source and intended evidence use before treating the record as reliable evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow fixes intended evidence use and checks identity, source, attribution, date/time/sequence and related controlled context before integrity classification.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat a controlled blank form or procedure as proof that the required activity occurred
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly rejects document/form status as proof of record execution.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: declare a record reliable solely because it has an approval or signature field
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Integrity classification states that formal approval or signature alone does not force reliable-evidence status.
